title_en: Huang Jingjia v. State — criminal state compensation case
keywords_en: state compensation; criminal compensation; Intermediate People's Court; Zhejiang Province; natural person; State Compensation Law; determination of wrongful arrest; initiation of compensation procedures; whether mental distress damages are compensable; partially upheld; wrongful arrest; case dismissed; restriction of personal liberty; corruption
full_text_en:
Huang Jingjia v. Zhejiang Province Pinghu Municipal People's Procuratorate — State Criminal Compensation Case

Compensation Claimant: Huang Jingjia, male, 47 years old, native of Pinghu City, Zhejiang Province, cadre of the Education Committee of Pinghu City, Zhejiang Province.

Agent ad litem: Xia Jianjun, lawyer of Zhejiang Junsheng Law Firm.

Agent ad litem: Xia Jixian, professor of East China University of Political Science and Law.

Compensation Obligor: Zhejiang Province Pinghu Municipal People's Procuratorate.

Legal Representative: Zhao Luming, Chief Procurator.

Review Authority: Zhejiang Province Jiaxing Municipal People's Procuratorate.

Legal Representative: Zhu Liqiao, Chief Procurator.

Huang Jingjia, on the grounds of having been wrongfully arrested and detained for a total of 204 days by Zhejiang Province Pinghu Municipal People's Procuratorate, filed a criminal compensation application with the Compensation Committee of Zhejiang Province Jiaxing Intermediate People's Court, requesting the Pinghu Municipal People's Procuratorate to compensate him for the infringement of his personal freedom, to pay RMB 50,000 for moral damages, and to publicly eliminate the adverse effects, restore his reputation, and make an apology.

The Compensation Committee of Jiaxing Intermediate People's Court, upon trial, found the following facts:

On October 7, 1998, based on a report, the Pinghu Municipal People's Procuratorate sent personnel to bring the compensation claimant Huang Jingjia to its Anti-Corruption Bureau for investigation. On October 9, Huang Jingjia was detained on suspicion of embezzlement during his tenure as the director of the general office of Pinghu Middle School and the person-in-charge of a school-run enterprise. On October 23, he was arrested on suspicion of embezzlement. On April 29, 1999, the Pinghu Municipal People's Procuratorate decided to release Huang Jingjia on bail pending further investigation and lifted the detention. On September 29 of the same year, the Pinghu Municipal People's Procuratorate, on the grounds that the whereabouts of the main witnesses were unknown, making it difficult to conclude the case, decided to dismiss the case of suspected embezzlement against Huang Jingjia. From October 7, 1998 to April 29, 1999, Huang Jingjia was deprived of personal freedom for a total of 204 days.

On May 22, 2000, the compensation claimant Huang Jingjia submitted a compensation application to the Pinghu Municipal People's Procuratorate on the grounds of wrongful arrest. On June 22 of the same year, the Pinghu Municipal People's Procuratorate issued a criminal confirmation letter, refusing to confirm the compensation claim. On June 26 of the same year, the compensation claimant Huang Jingjia filed an appeal with the review authority, the Jiaxing Municipal People's Procuratorate. On August 25 of the same year, the Jiaxing Municipal People's Procuratorate issued a decision on the review of the criminal confirmation complaint, affirming the decision of the Pinghu Municipal People's Procuratorate not to confirm.

The evidence confirming the above facts includes: the investigation records of Huang Jingjia by the Pinghu Municipal People's Procuratorate on October 7 and October 8, 1998; the detention notice (Pingjian Fantan Jutong (98) No. 9), arrest notice (Pingjian Fantan Daitong (1998) No. 9), guarantee letter (Pingjian Baoshu (1999) No. 12), case dismissal decision (Pingjian Che'an (1999) No. 1), and criminal confirmation letter (Pingjian Quezi (2000) No. 1) of the Pinghu Municipal People's Procuratorate; and the decision on review of criminal confirmation complaint (Zhejiang Jianjian Quefu Juezi (2000) No. 1) of the Jiaxing Municipal People's Procuratorate.

The compensation obligor argued in its defense that: This case has not been confirmed and thus cannot enter the compensation procedure; the Compensation Committee should not accept the case. The compensation claimant Huang Jingjia had facts of embezzlement, and the case was dismissed only because the main witnesses had left at the time of the incident and their whereabouts remain unknown, resulting in evidence not meeting the standard of sufficiency and certainty for prosecution; thus, the detention was not wrongful and compensation should not be paid.

The Compensation Committee of Jiaxing Intermediate People's Court held that:

According to the provisions of Article 15 of the State Compensation Law of the People's Republic of China, where an organ exercising the powers of investigation, prosecution, trial, or prison administration, or its personnel, wrongfully arrests a person who has not committed a crime, it constitutes an infringement of personal rights, and the victim has the right to obtain compensation. The Pinghu Municipal People's Procuratorate, on the grounds of suspected embezzlement, forcibly restricted the personal freedom of compensation claimant Huang Jingjia for 204 days, which is clearly established. The case of suspected embezzlement against Huang Jingjia was ultimately dismissed because the Pinghu Municipal People's Procuratorate considered that the evidence did not meet the standard of sufficiency and certainty for prosecution, which in essence means that there was no evidence to prove that the suspect had committed a crime. Arresting a person without being able to prove that the suspect has committed a crime constitutes a wrongful arrest of a person without criminal facts. The victim has the right to file a criminal compensation claim against the judicial organ that issued the wrongful arrest decision. Therefore, the compensation claimant Huang Jingjia's request that the Pinghu Municipal People's Procuratorate, as the compensation obligor, compensate him for his losses, complies with the law.

The compensation obligor, the Pinghu Municipal People's Procuratorate, has already made a decision not to confirm the compensation application of Huang Jingjia; the review authority, the Jiaxing Municipal People's Procuratorate, after review, affirmed the decision of the Pinghu Municipal People's Procuratorate. These two decisions resulted in the state criminal compensation application of Huang Jingjia not entering the state compensation procedure when it should have. The decision of the Pinghu Municipal People's Procuratorate not to confirm and the review decision of the Jiaxing Municipal People's Procuratorate shall be deemed as the compensation obligor and the review authority having respectively made decisions not to compensate. The compensation claimant Huang Jingjia, believing that the decisions of the compensation obligor and the review authority violate the provisions of the State Compensation Law, has filed a compensation claim with the Compensation Committee of this court, and this court should accept it in accordance with the law.

Article 20 of the State Compensation Law of the People's Republic of China provides: "The compensation obligor shall provide compensation for any of the circumstances provided for in Article 15 or Article 16 of this Law that have been confirmed in accordance with the law." The Pinghu Municipal People's Procuratorate, without sufficient evidence to prove that Huang Jingjia had committed embezzlement, arrested him on suspicion of embezzlement, thereby infringing upon the citizen's personal rights. The Pinghu Municipal People's Procuratorate shall, as the compensation obligor, assume state compensation liability for criminal infringement in accordance with the law and actually perform its compensation obligation.

Article 25 of the State Compensation Law of the People's Republic of China provides: "State compensation is mainly in the form of payment of compensation money." Article 26 provides: "For infringement of citizens' personal freedom, the daily compensation amount shall be calculated according to the national average daily wage of employees in the preceding year." The compensation obligor's provision of state compensation to the victim shall be based on the scope of compensation provided for in the State Compensation Law. The compensation claimant Huang Jingjia's request that the compensation obligor, the Pinghu Municipal People's Procuratorate, compensate him for the infringement of his personal freedom, and eliminate the adverse effects, restore his reputation, and make an apology, is in accordance with the law. The Pinghu Municipal People's Procuratorate shall make compensation in accordance with the law, and eliminate the adverse effects, restore reputation, and apologize for the compensation claimant. However, the compensation claimant Huang Jingjia's request for the compensation obligor to pay moral damages exceeds the scope of compensation provided for in the State Compensation Law and has no other legal basis, so it is not supported in accordance with the law.

In conclusion, the Compensation Committee of Zhejiang Province Jiaxing Intermediate People's Court decided on November 12, 2000, as follows:

Zhejiang Province Pinghu Municipal People's Procuratorate shall compensate Huang Jingjia in the amount of RMB 6,705. This shall be performed within 15 days from the date of receipt of this decision.

This decision is legally effective.
